examples.en: She sings beautifully, and she can dance as well.
Miss Wu is our class teacher and our friend as well.
examples.zh: 吴小姐不仅是我们的老师，还是我们的朋友。
examples.rewrite: = Miss Wu is not only our class teacher but also our friend.

examples.en: I'll ask for your help if I can't work out the problem.
examples.zh: 如果我解不出这题，我会请你帮忙。

examples.en: When playing basketball, we can enjoy the sunshine and fresh air at the same time.
examples.zh: 打篮球时，我们可以同时享受阳光和新鲜的空气。
